rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for earnestly advising or recommending something.

example.english: I often preach the benefits of working from home.
example.traditional: 我成日勸人返工喺屋企做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 hyun3 jan4 faan1 gung1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone is delivering a religious sermon.

example.english: The pastor is going to preach a sermon at church today.
example.jyutping: muk6 si1 gam1 jat6 hai2 gaau3 tong4 gong2 dou6

rows.note: Use this when someone gives unwanted moral advice or lectures people in a preachy way.

example.english: Don't preach at me all the time.
example.traditional: 你唔好成日對住我說教啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 syut3 gaau3 laa1
